description: This file defines utility functions to convert between enum types and strings, as well as a function to extract file protocol from a URL string. It specifically handles conversion for SourceType, PlayMode, and AudioType enums, and provides a helper to parse 'file://' URLs.

methods.name: sourceTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a SourceType enum based on matching values.

methods.name: sourceTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a SourceType enum to its corresponding string.

methods.name: playModeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to a PlayMode enum.

methods.name: playModeToString
methods.description: Converts a PlayMode enum to its string representation.

methods.name: audioTypeFromString
methods.description: Converts a string to an AudioType enum.

methods.name: audioTypeToString
methods.description: Converts an AudioType enum to its string.

methods.name: extractFileProtocol
methods.description: Checks if the URL string starts with 'file://' and if so, removes the protocol prefix and modifies the string in-place.
